_comment: Brand-level termbank (M4). Universal layer — merged UNDER each profile's own glossary.json by authoring.load_glossary(). 'preferred' entries inject approved terms into the generation prompt and lint any phrase in 'instead_of' as a wrong-term error. 'banned' words raise a blocking lint error if they appear in generated markdown. Words match whole-word, case-insensitive. Tune freely — this is data, no code change needed.
